 Myojin Tomokazu (48) of Gamba Osaka (Japan) vowed to win.
 Gamba will face the Pohang Steelers in Game 4 of the AFC Champions League Elite (ACLE) League Stage in the 2026-27 season at 7 p.m. on November 4 at Pohang Steelyard.
 Gamba is unbeaten (2 wins and 1 draw) in three ACLE games this season. However, he is struggling with 13 games, two wins, six draws and five losses (12 points). Gamba is 16th out of 20 J1 League clubs, two points ahead of Jeff United Chiba, who is in the relegation zone.
 사진 확대 Myojin Tomokazu Gamba, director of Osaka. Photo = Reporter Lee Geun-seung Coach Myo Jin expressed his determination to continue his unbeaten streak ahead of the match against Pohang. This is the story that manager Myo Jin told at a press conference before the game at Stillyard on the 3rd.
 Q. Resolution for the Pohang game. 
 This is the fourth round of the ACLE League Stage. Our primary goal is to pass the league stage. In order to achieve the goal, Pohang must also sound the victory. It's a very important game. It is not easy to play both the J1 League and ACLE. The schedule is very tight. There are games that cannot be missed. But I'll prepare well. I want to go back to Pohang with 3 points.
 Q. Unlike ACLE, it is slowing down in the J1 League. I also have to play league schedules on weekends. Do you have any plans for rotation in Pohang. 
 I played the game before. The match against Pohang is the first game in two days after the league game. The most important thing now is to recover physically and mentally. How well you recover determines success or failure. There was not much time to prepare, but Pohang was thoroughly analyzed. For two days, I had a full discussion about the tactics with the players. There is still time left. I'll prepare well until the end.
 사진 확대 Gamba Osaka won the AFC Champions League Two (ACL2) last season. Gamba beat Al Nasr (Saudi Arabia) 1-0 in the ACL2 final last season, where Cristiano Ronaldo, Sadio Mane and Joao Palix endured. 사진=AFPBBNews=News1 Q. The J1 League is in its first season of the transition to the spring season. I haven't played a full season yet, but do you feel any changes. 
 I don't feel much about the change of the autumn system right now. One thing is to prepare for the heat. The season started in August. It went through a different preparation process than the previous season. There were some difficulties at the opening point. But now it's okay in everything. The weather has gotten a lot better, too. It is the best environment to play soccer.
 [Pohang = Lee Geunseung, MK Sports Reporter]
